task_language: stack the middle black bowl on the back black bowl

subtasks.name: stack(middle_black_bowl, back_black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: failed: bowl carried past the back bowl to the cabinet top (127) and held there tilted until 409

behaviour_summary: pi0 picks the correct middle bowl, carries it over and past the back bowl to the top/front edge of the cabinet on the image right, and holds it there tilted against the cabinet for ~280 steps.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 grasps the correct object but transports it to a location other than the instructed destination and holds it there.
failures.hl_remedy: HALT -> VERIFY(bowl still in gripper) -> RETREAT(up 5 cm, 10 cm away from the cabinet toward the table centre) -> REPROMPT 'pick up the middle black bowl and place it on the back black bowl' -> WATCH 3 s that the EE moves toward the back bowl -> VERIFY(bowl on back bowl); retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: While an object is held, WATCH that the EE moves toward the destination ROI; HALT if it moves away from the destination for 2 frames.
failures.observation: Steps 60-87: gripper descends on the image-left (middle) bowl and lifts it. 100: bowl lifted near the back bowl. 113: moving to the right past the back bowl. 127-140: bowl at the cabinet top edge on the image right. 147-409: bowl held tilted against the cabinet front/top near the handles; the back bowl stays in place on the table.

notes: The cabinet is not a destination in this task. It may be pi0 drawn to the cabinet as a habitual target in KITCHEN_SCENE2 (compare the task11 drawer episodes).
